notes: Sepolia-only application deployment (chain ID 11155111): seven accepted contracts in constructor dependency order. $owner receives every ownership role, both initial royalty allocations and the MockOG initial supply. $contract references resolve only to earlier entries. MockOG and MockSwarmPepe are Sepolia-only mocks, also used in local tests; this manifest is not for mainnet. MockOG has 18 decimals, one trillion tokens initially, and unrestricted public minting with no supply cap. MockSwarmPepe publicly mints unused Pepe IDs to the caller. Staking uses 1e18 point units per whole token per day and the existing rounded-up 1% unstake fee to the farm vault. The Sepolia raffle notice is 0. Furniture and clubs start with 5% royalties, bounded at 10%. The factory deploys nonpayable constructors only; no role grants, initialization calls or ETH funding are included. Before creating the first raffle, $owner must execute furniture.grantMinter(raffle) as furniture's FIRST grant and staking.grantSpender(raffle) as staking's FIRST grant, using confirmed deployed addresses, then verify minters(raffle) and spenders(raffle). These first grants are immediate. Later grants require activation from proposal+7 through proposal+14 days inclusive; revocation is immediate. Clubs consume neither first grant. OGClubClubs constructor order is token, vault, price, furniture, owner, royaltyReceiver, pepes, delegates, UpgradePrices. The static UpgradePrices tuple is flattened into level2, level3, level4 as the final three ABI words. Mint price is 100_000e18; upgrade prices are 200_000e18, 400_000e18 and 800_000e18. All prices are immutable. Each payment sends floor(amount/2) to the fixed burn sink and the remainder to the farm vault, with exact payer debit and receipt checks. Sink transfers do not reduce ERC-20 totalSupply. The configured delegate.xyz v2 address is the one specified in the brief; live registry availability is not established by this manifest. The Pepe holder or authorized delegate pays and receives club #pepeId, once per Pepe forever. Clubs mint at level 1; the holder or approved operator can pay to upgrade through level 4. Rooms grow from 10x10 to 16x16 without moving pieces. Floor tiles reserve (0,4) and (1,4); wall side 1 reserves position 4. Each club permanently holds at most one piece per design and 285 pieces total, with contents following club transfers. Factory deployment leaves the sale closed, metadata empty and footprints unset. $owner separately configures metadata, setFootprint(id,w,h,wall) and sale opening; footprints lock on first placement. The sample footprint catalogue is Sepolia-only. A separate mainnet deployment uses existing OG_TOKEN, FARM_VAULT, FURNITURE and SWARM_PEPES, with neither mock. The mainnet clubs script checks FARM_VAULT.token() == OG_TOKEN before deploying from DEPLOYER_KEY, passes OWNER (which may be a Safe), and prints owner configuration calldata and constructor arguments. The mainnet raffle handoff uses a fresh deployer, a Safe OWNER and RAFFLE_NOTICE=604800. See README.md for owner setup and deployment details.
